bg.title: Оценка на наблюдаемостта и надеждността
bg.intro: 22 въпроса в 11 области: от златните сигнали и OpenTelemetry до SLO, дежурства, зависимости и тестове за устойчивост. Резултатът показва зрелост по области, критични пропуски, примерна телеметрична архитектура и списък със следващи стъпки.
bg.disclaimer: Самооценка по вашите отговори. Не се свързваме с вашите системи за наблюдение, не измерваме наличност или надеждност и не потвърждаваме постигнати SLO. Примерните SLI и SLO са само илюстрация.

pattern_example_slos.title: Примерни SLI и SLO (само илюстративни)

en.title: Observability & Reliability Assessment
en.intro: 22 questions across 11 areas: from golden signals and OpenTelemetry to SLOs, on-call, dependencies and resilience testing. The result shows maturity per area, critical gaps, a reference telemetry architecture and a next-step backlog.
en.disclaimer: A self-assessment based on your answers. We do not connect to your monitoring systems, measure availability or reliability, or confirm any SLO achievement. Example SLIs and SLOs are illustrative only.

golden_signals.description: Latency, traffic, errors and saturation for key services and user journeys.

telemetry.description: What is collected centrally and whether it can be correlated per request.

otel.title: OpenTelemetry instrumentation
otel.description: Standard instrumentation and a collector with sampling and filtering.

slo.title: SLIs, SLOs and error budgets
slo.description: Measurable reliability targets and how they are used.

alerting.description: Who receives alerts and how many of them require action.

incidents.title: Incident response and on-call
incidents.description: An incident process and sustainable on-call.

runbooks.title: Runbooks and escalation
runbooks.description: Runbooks linked to alerts and a clear escalation path.

capacity.title: Capacity and performance
capacity.description: Capacity monitoring, forecasting and load testing.

dependencies.title: Dependency visibility
dependencies.description: A dependency map and monitoring of external services.

change_failure.title: Change failure analysis
change_failure.description: Linking changes to incidents and rolling back quickly.

resilience.title: Disaster recovery and resilience testing
resilience.description: Tested recovery and planned failure testing.

initial.title: Initial
initial.description: Most practices are manual or missing; risk depends on individual people.

developing.title: Developing
developing.description: Basic practices exist, but not everywhere and not consistently.

defined.title: Defined
defined.description: Practices are standardised and most are applied automatically.

optimised.title: Optimised
optimised.description: Practices are automated, measured and continuously improved.

risk_no_alerts.title: Customers find the problems first
risk_no_alerts.description: Without alerts nobody learns about an outage until a customer complains.

risk_blind_spots.title: Blind spots in telemetry
risk_blind_spots.description: Too few signals are collected to understand why something broke.

risk_no_incident_process.title: No incident process
risk_no_incident_process.description: Without roles and steps every incident lasts longer and depends on who is available.

risk_untested_recovery.title: Untested recovery
risk_untested_recovery.description: Recovery that has never been tested usually fails when it is needed.

risk_external_blind.title: External dependencies are invisible
risk_external_blind.description: A provider outage looks like your own outage and takes time to identify.

qw_on_call_routing.title: Alerts to an on-call person
qw_on_call_routing.description: Route critical alerts to an on-call person instead of e-mail.

qw_golden_signals.title: The four golden signals for one key service
qw_golden_signals.description: Start with latency, traffic, errors and saturation of the service that matters most.

qw_alert_noise.title: Clean up alerts
qw_alert_noise.description: Silence or merge alerts that need no action; every remaining one gets an owner.

qw_top_runbooks.title: Runbooks for the five most frequent alerts
qw_top_runbooks.description: Short check and recovery steps, linked from the alert itself.

qw_deploy_markers.title: Deployment markers on dashboards
qw_deploy_markers.description: Show every deployment on the graphs so changes and incidents can be linked.

rec_golden_signals.title: Service health from golden signals
rec_golden_signals.description: Dashboards per service and user journey, each with an owner.

rec_telemetry.title: Correlated telemetry
rec_telemetry.description: Central logs, metrics and traces, correlated by trace identifier.

rec_otel.title: OpenTelemetry as the standard
rec_otel.description: Vendor-neutral instrumentation and a collector with sampling and filtering.

rec_slo.title: SLOs for critical services
rec_slo.description: Measurable targets agreed with the business, and error budgets.

rec_alerting.title: Alerts that require action
rec_alerting.description: Alerts on SLOs and symptoms instead of every metric.

rec_incidents.title: Incident process and sustainable on-call
rec_incidents.description: Roles, communication, blameless reviews and a reasonable load.

rec_runbooks.title: Runbooks and escalation
rec_runbooks.description: A runbook for every alert and a documented escalation path.

rec_capacity.title: Capacity with a forecast
rec_capacity.description: A forecast per service and load tests before peaks.

rec_dependencies.title: Visible dependencies
rec_dependencies.description: A map from traces and your own checks of external services.

rec_change_failure.title: Change failure analysis
rec_change_failure.description: Deployment markers and automatic rollback on degradation.

rec_resilience.title: Tested resilience
rec_resilience.description: Regular recovery tests and planned failure exercises.

pattern_telemetry_architecture.title: Suggested reference telemetry architecture
pattern_telemetry_architecture.description: OpenTelemetry SDKs and auto-instrumentation → a collector (sampling, personal-data filtering, enrichment) → stores for metrics, logs and traces → dashboards and SLO alerts, correlated by trace identifier.

pattern_example_slos.title: Example SLIs and SLOs (illustrative only)
pattern_example_slos.description: Examples, not recommended values: availability = share of successful requests over 28 days, e.g. 99.5%; latency = share of requests under a threshold, e.g. 95% under 500 ms. Set your own values from real data and user needs.

ts_error_budget_policy.title: An error budget policy
ts_error_budget_policy.description: When the budget runs low, new features wait and the team works on reliability.

ts_game_days.title: Regular failure exercises
ts_game_days.description: Planned exercises in production with guardrails, with tracked follow-ups.
